name: kannada-late-night
brief: Late at night, winding down. You want soft, romantic Kannada film melodies: slow, tender, melodic. Nothing loud, no item numbers, no dance tracks.

name: kannada-mass
brief: Pumped up. You want Kannada mass and hype songs: hero-intro numbers, big drums, whistles, high energy. Slow love songs kill the mood.

name: hindi-romantic
brief: In a romantic, slightly wistful mood. You want Hindi romantic songs in the Arijit Singh mould: soulful, melodic, mid-tempo. No party or dance tracks.

name: punjabi-hindi-party
brief: Getting ready for a party. You want Punjabi and Hindi party tracks: bhangra beats, club remixes, Badshah / Diljit / Yo Yo Honey Singh energy. Ballads are skips.

name: tamil-anirudh
brief: You want high-energy Tamil songs in the Anirudh Ravichander style: punchy, electronic, catchy hooks, mass and dance numbers. Slow melodies are not what you came for.

name: telugu-mass
brief: You want Telugu mass songs: loud, fast, folk-percussion or EDM-driven, the kind that plays at a hero's entry. Soft melodies are skips.

name: indian-heartbreak
brief: Heartbroken. You want sad Indian film songs about loss and longing, in any Indian language: slow, aching, emotional. Anything upbeat or celebratory breaks the mood.

name: english-chill
brief: Unwinding with a book. You want chill English music: lo-fi, acoustic, soft indie, mellow singer-songwriter. Nothing loud, no rap, no EDM drops.

name: english-workout
brief: At the gym, mid-workout. You want English workout hype: hard-hitting hip-hop, EDM, rock anthems, high tempo. Anything slow or mellow is a skip.

name: film-bgm
brief: Working and want no lyrics in the way. You want Indian film instrumentals and background scores (BGM, themes), any language. Songs with vocals are skips.
